title: Shopping is moving to AI agents, and our store must be ready for them
summary: Amazon: 400M customers used Alexa for Shopping, spending 50% more, and wins 59% of AI-assisted purchases (PYMNTS). NIQ: 55% use AI in discovery. Walmart added agent spend limits. Asus sees PC prices up ~10% in 2H26.

points.headline: AI assistants drive discovery and spend, and Amazon is winning the checkout
points.detail: 400M customers used Alexa for Shopping and spend 50% more; Amazon wins 59% of AI-assisted purchases; NIQ finds 55% use AI in discovery. Our catalog must be purchasable by assistants.

points.headline: Retailers are building agent rules and holding discovery in-house
points.detail: Amazon expanded Shop Direct and positioned Alexa to counter outside AI agents; Walmart and Home Depot set rules for AI shoppers. We should check how our listings appear to agents.

points.headline: Memory shortage lifts PC prices and keeps overall demand weak
points.detail: Asus expects Taiwan commercial PC prices up nearly 10% in 2H26; Samsung sees no buyer relief before 2028; Intel flags weak PC demand. We should plan pricing, inventory and financing.

points.headline: Regulators and rivals reshape holiday pricing and deal windows
points.detail: FTC ordered Target, Walmart and others to detail personalized pricing; Walmart stretched Black Friday/Cyber Monday to 14 days. We should check our deal calendar and pricing transparency.

points.headline: Google takes a half-billion stake in JD.com, a marketplace channel for us
points.detail: Google is to invest half a billion in JD.com. We should watch for changes to JD.com seller programs, search and discovery that affect how our products appear there.
